headword: {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}

definitions.gloss: performance technique; playing technique; musical skill
definitions.explanation: The technical skill and proficiency involved in playing a musical instrument or performing music. Encompasses both fundamental mechanics and advanced expressive techniques.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{演奏者|えんそうしゃ}→演奏者：25426_ensousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This performer has a high level of playing technique.

examples.japanese: {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧⟦{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}→表現力：21315_hyougenryoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Not only performance technique but also expressive ability is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ことで、{演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確実|かくじつ}→確実：02538_kakujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}する→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: By continuing to practice every day, your performance technique will steadily improve.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧ (musical performance) and ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (technique, skill). Used in music education, reviews, and competitions to evaluate or discuss a performer's technical abilities. In Japanese music criticism, there is a traditional distinction between {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ} (technical proficiency) and {音楽性|おんがくせい} (musicality), with the ideal being a balance of both.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish one's playing technique
- {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to have excellent technique
- {演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧: improvement of performance skill
- ⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧な{演奏技術|えんそうぎじゅつ}: advanced performance technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: musical performance — the act itself, not the skill level
- ⟦{技巧|ぎこう}→技巧：12779_gikou⟧: virtuosity, artistry — emphasizes the artistic or virtuosic aspect of technique
- {奏法|そうほう}: playing method — focuses on the specific way an instrument is played (bowing, fingering, etc.)
